transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

My wife and son really pushed for me to get an evaluation because they're worried about me. My wife says I’ve been acting all over the place at work and at home, like I can’t control what I’m doing or keep it appropriate to what’s going on. I just feel really overwhelmed by it all.
Have you had periods where you felt unusually high, extremely energetic, or unusually irritable, lasting for several days or more?

No, I haven't experienced anything like feeling unusually high, extremely energetic, or irritable for days at a time. My main issues are more about feeling jumbled, disorganized, and out of control with my actions. It's not that I have too much energy, I just can't seem to keep things straight anymore.
Have you noticed problems with your memory, thinking clearly, or concentrating, such as forgetting things easily or having trouble following conversations?

Yes, I've had a really hard time keeping my thoughts on track and thinking clearly. When I try to explain simple things, my mind suddenly drifts off into unrelated patterns, like barcodes, and I can't get back to the point. People just stare at me like I'm speaking nonsense, even though it makes sense to me at the time.
Have you ever seen, heard, or felt things that others don’t, such as voices or strange sensations, even if you know they’re not real?

No, I haven't experienced seeing, hearing, or feeling things that aren't there. My main struggles are really just with my thoughts getting all jumbled up and my physical behaviors feeling completely out of my control lately.
When your thoughts drift off into patterns like barcodes, do they ever feel so fast or disconnected that you can't even make sense of them yourself?

Actually, in my own head, those thoughts and the barcode patterns make perfect sense and feel completely connected at the time. The real frustration is that my mouth just can't seem to get back to the point I was making, so other people stare at me like I'm talking complete nonsense. To me, it all fits together perfectly, but I just can't get it out right.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with disorganized thinking and speech, subjective thought disorder with internally coherent but externally incoherent ideation (e.g., barcode patterns), and behavioral disorganization, in the absence of mood episodes or perceptual disturbances. These are hallmark features of schizotypal disorder, which aligns with F20.3 (Schizotypal disorder) under ICD-10.
